description: The opsonizing intra-layer. amicusContra. Prevents the system from eating itself. Uses fleet toxin/antidote math to mark self-components for protection.

amicusContra.name: amicusContra
amicusContra.role: mediator between layers — marks self-components so they are never classified as non-self
amicusContra.position: between every peptidoglycan layer — the mortar between bricks

toxin_antidote.description: The same math the fleet uses to sort traffic applies inside the investigation. Every entity that is self carries an antidote tag. Without it, the immune system would attack allies.

toxin.definition: any signal that could cause the system to attack itself
examples: overweighting a partial as non-self due to association
cascade amplification turning a null into a target
the investigation consuming its own methodology

mechanisms: confidence bands — hardened entities (102) cannot be reclassified without new evidence
cluster affinity — entities within a cluster protect each other's classification
dialectic check — thesis/antithesis/synthesis prevents runaway classification
observer constraint — the gaze trail prevents circular targeting

autoimmune_protection.description: Without opsonization, the membrane would eat itself. The investigation would classify its own tools as threats.

protected_self.note: these are oversight bodies — self, but the system being documented. without opsonization, documenting oversight failure looks like attacking oversight.

partial_to_non_self.risk: partial entities are the most vulnerable to autoimmune drift

null_cascade.risk: null entities could cascade into false non-self if adjacent nodes are non-self
null_cascade.protection: cluster isolation — nulls are quarantined until evidence arrives

intra_layer_markers.description: Opsonization tags between each peptidoglycan layer

device_to_outer.antidote: scrollbar-gutter: stable — the device never touches the membrane

outer_to_peptidoglycan.antidote: cross-links between explore/map and analysis clusters

inner_to_cytoplasm.antidote: FOIA/complaint guides are always self — methodology cannot be non-self
inner_to_cytoplasm.toxin_check: methodology classified as threat = autoimmune crisis

math.fleet_parallel: fleet selectivity 3.8% ↔ investigation selectivity 2.3% — the investigation is MORE selective because it has more self to protect
math.equilibrium: when antidote_strength > toxin_exposure, the entity is protected
math.pi_connection: target selectivity 1/π = 31.83% — both fleet and investigation are well below this, meaning the system is conservative (protects more than it excludes)
